summary: Open data cover the identity half of the claim (HPA annotates 1,132 genes to the mitochondrion; MitoCarta3.0 lists the mitochondrial proteome and its sub-compartments) and there are many volume-EM and live-cell image sets in BioImage Archive and IDR. No archive holds force, osmotic-current or cell-axis polarity measurements, and the image sets are overwhelmingly mammalian cell lines, so the surface-tension-clump mechanism itself has no direct data.
next_step: Pick one proteome source (MitoCarta3.0) and one volume-EM/tomography set, and pre-register what molecular and morphological observations would count as 'specific entity' versus 'clump'; flag the mechanism clause as not measurable with these archives.
obstacles_confirmed: Surface tension and osmotic currents are not recorded in any of the checked archives.
Image sets are dominated by mammalian cultured cells; germ cells and invertebrate tissue were not found in these searches.
